_meta_itemized.notes: Handwritten entries on the printed 2018 grid; the PDF's OCR layer is noise on both ledger pages, so both were read full-page at 200 dpi and one row escalated to a 900 dpi tight crop for the geometry spot-check (band 4 p2 reproduced 'Sherry Hanks' / $600). BOTH printed template specimen rows survive unstruck on this filing (Jon and Jane Doe $435.00, Name of Business $512.00) and both printed/cover totals close only without them. THE CONTRIBUTION SHEET'S ENTIRE DATE COLUMN IS EMPTY - the filer wrote three donors with amounts, addresses and zips but no dates at all; those are honest blanks (needs_review=1), never back-filled from the report date. Per the privacy contract only city/state are kept from the Mailing Address column; the filer printed no separate state column, so state is read off the written city ('SLC', 'Idaho Falls', 'PC') and never off the zip. The last expense line has SEMANTICALLY SWAPPED cells - 'Filing Fee' sits in the Person-or-Organization column and 'County Clerk' in the Purpose column - so the two are assigned by meaning and the as-printed placement is named on the row. THIS FILING AND ITS POST-ELECTION SIBLING 8366 ARE THE SAME SHEET RE-FILED UNCHANGED (identical rows, identical boxed total, identical cover 900.00 / 858.19 / 41.81) - the known Summit re-file behaviour, not a duplication bug; both were transcribed independently.
